observations: Photo 0: Yellow LPG gas cylinder with carrying handle, sitting on marble-look floor tiles, cardboard boxes in background. Top valve area shows no regulator/valve fitted, just a plug. A label on the neck is attached but text is not legible. Some scuffs and small rust dots on the body.

Photo 1: Blue LPG gas cylinder with handle, placed on white floor tiles near a doorway, other items (bottles, bucket) in background. A round logo on the body reads 'BERADISCO'. Neck area shows a plug/nut, no regulator attached. Paint worn at the neck and bottom collar, some rust streaks.

Photo 2: Same blue cylinder as photo 1, viewed from a different angle, same 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark. Confirms no valve/regulator fitted, just a brass-colored nut. Cylinder sits on gray marble-look tile, cardboard box and other items in background.
